title: SereneLife 50" Smart Electric Fireplace Insert with Heater (New)

comparisons.notes: Model SLFPE50WBK, black, 50 in., built-in or wall-mount, 750W/1500W, Wi-Fi app control, 13 LED flame colors; same unit; no sold-out notice.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN from Woot offer page; checker verified exact match (black SLFPE50WBK.5, UPC 198076000779).
writeup: SereneLife's 50-inch smart electric fireplace insert is new at Woot for $129.99. It can be recessed into a wall or wall-mounted, runs at 750W or 1500W, heats up to about 400 square feet, and has Wi-Fi app control with 13 LED flame colors. SereneLife's own site lists the same SLFPE50WBK for $312.61, so this is about 58% less.
